method: Diagnostic after primary evaluation. Interpolate each RGB record-time label boundary into RGB header-time using sampled frames; clamp at first/last RGB sample. Select LiDAR by header-time. Does not establish cross-sensor clock synchronization or contact phase truth. Geometry and acceptance parameters unchanged.
